provenance: measured on the canonical nested validation split with the exact per-scope persistence arithmetic of scripts/evaluate_realdata_phase2.py; horizon scopes hold persistence at y_true[start-1] over the whole rollout
frame_partition: every ceiling uses the SAME per-trial frame partition and frame-weighting the scorer's _pooled_mse skill uses (sum over per-trial eligible frames weighted by their own counts), NOT a single global pool: aligned/onset use t>=1 aligned frames; escape (b) uses the t>=1 frames with |y_true[t]|>=10 cm/s per trial; h5/h25/h125 use the (start,k) rollout frames over 8 evenly-spaced starts, and their *_escape variants restrict the SAME (start,k) pairs to |y_true|>=10 cm/s
reconciliation: scripts/evaluate_realdata_phase2.py recomputes each scope's persistence MSE on the scored data and asserts it matches these frozen values at rel 1e-3, emitting ceiling_vs_measured_delta and failing closed on a mismatch (M3)
note: The h=5 held-at-start ceiling (0.925) is the comparator the scorer divides by; the step-1 audit's pure lag-5 value (10.07) is a different comparator and scores no phase-2 slot. The setup audit (docs/realdata-exploratory-step1-20261010.md) reports the pure lag-N values only; this artifact adds the held-at-start values and the onset ceiling the phase-2 scorer uses.
